# AI Voiceover (Edge TTS)

Turn an ecommerce voice-over script into per-line AI audio with Microsoft's free Edge online voices (via the edge-tts package): the script is rewritten into speakable lines (8–20 characters per line, numbers spelled as read, a subtitle version keeping the original spelling), each line is synthesised with a chosen voice, rate and pitch, silence-trimmed locally with ffmpeg, saved as 48 kHz mono WAV, and its real duration is recorded in durations.json so subtitles and shots align to the actual voice. Unchanged lines are served from a local cache with no new network call.
